If you are calling to schedule a new trip, or to confirm or make changes to an existing trip, press 1.

If you are calling for “Where’s My Ride,” press 2.

If you are a new member, press 3.

Si llama para programar un viaje nuevo, o para confirmar o hacer cambios a un viaje existente, oprima uno.

Si llama por “¿Dónde está mi viaje?”, oprima dos.

Si es un miembro nuevo, oprima tres.

TextelAPIBaseURL = "https://foundation.textel.net"
TextelApiKey = "eXmSm1jXpGt3aQBviq2yyu3GUiAAi99W" //API key here
//Message to send here
TextelMsgToSend = "Welcome! Click the link to quickly book and manage your rides in the member portal: https://kpma.member.saferidehealth.com/login?src=campaign_ivrsys Your transportation is just a few taps away!"
//Destination Number
TextelMobilePhoneNumber = "+1{global:ANI}"
//Caller ID
TextelLinePhoneNumber = "+18559325412" //phone number here


ASSIGN TextelSendMessageURL="{TextelAPIBaseURL}/clientapi/v1/nice/send-message"

Textel_Send_Message_Proxy = GetRESTProxy()
Textel_Send_Message_Proxy.AddHeader("Authorization","Bearer {TextelApiKey}")
Textel_Send_Message_Proxy.ContentType = "application/json"
Textel_Send_Message_Proxy.ProxyTimeoutSeconds = 60

//Request Body
DYNAMIC TextelSendMessageRequestBody
TextelSendMessageRequestBody.to="{TextelMobilePhoneNumber}"
TextelSendMessageRequestBody.from="{TextelLinePhoneNumber}"
TextelSendMessageRequestBody.body="{TextelMsgToSend}"
TextelSendMessageRequestBody.continueChat="true"
TextelSendMessageRequestBody.contactId="{ContactID}"
ASSIGN TextelSendMessageJSONPayload = "{TextelSendMessageRequestBody.asjson()}"

TextelSendMessageJSONPayload = TextelSendMessageJSONPayload.replace($"\"true\"","true")

//Make REST Request 
Textel_Send_Message_Proxy.MakeRestRequest(TextelSendMessageURL,TextelSendMessageJSONPayload,0,"POST")
